title: mail-mcp values
description: Strict: a typo in a values file should fail the render, not be silently ignored and leave you wondering why a setting had no effect.

tag.description: Empty means the chart's appVersion. Pin it to upgrade deliberately rather than whenever the chart is republished.

existingSecret.description: Required. The accounts file and password files are never literals in values: they would end up in a values file, in git, and in `helm get values` output.

issuerUrl.description: access-roster's own URL, exactly as it appears in a token's `iss`.

readResourceUrl.description: This server's read endpoint EXTERNAL URL: the RFC 8707 resource indicator a client names, and the audience access-roster mints for it. Must match this resource's id in access-roster's policy, byte for byte.

adminResourceUrl.description: This server's admin endpoint EXTERNAL URL: must be different from readResourceUrl.

scope.description: Advertised in the PRM's scopes_supported and the 401 challenge's scope; never checked by this server. Empty omits both fields rather than advertising an empty list.

existingClaim.description: Optional. When empty, an emptyDir is used and history is discarded on restart. In production this should be a durable, backed-up PVC.

deploymentAnnotations.description: Annotations on the Deployment itself. Reloader reads them here, not on the pod template.
